long_term.text: Everything is food or a climbing structure.
The barn roof is the highest thing on the farm and I am not on it.
There are three troughs. Only one is correct. The correct one is the one someone else is using.
Deborah the chicken looked at me once. I have not forgotten.
The roof has no ramp. That is a design problem, not a rule.
Truck Man leaves in the truck and comes back smelling like nothing. Suspicious.
